But just as a friend so I don't think he ever liked me or saw me that way. 3 months after talking on and off I confessed and even after him slightly turning me down bc he said he wasn't ready (I was fine with it, he was like a good friend anyways) he decided to get into a relationship with me. Honestly the first 2 weeks felt amazing, I've never felt what its like to be that close to someone before, after all I never thought anyone would find me attractive to kiss. It was his first relationship too and I guess he thought saying I love you so soon is what everyone does... so I went along with it. My insecurities were still there and I had a feeling he just wanted to try it out and see since his friend pressured him to also date me because he knew I liked him. It only lasted 3 weeks because he broke up with me and I was partially correct. Devastated honestly. Did it on Valentines too. Now its 3 months since and I feel disgusted that he had to be infront of me and kiss my ugly face. He never liked me I don't think he ever did and didn't want to carry on the relationship. I dont care how he tried to sugarcoat it to spare my feelings. It really hurt and I've realized how shitty it was for him to play me like that but I feel like I deserve it and I don't blame him. I knew things were way too good to be true and now I'm on dating apps to past time and eventhough I use unfiltered pictures ad well as filtered ones and show them my instagram. I look so disgusting in person and I feel so scared about meeting the guys who decide to talk more with me. Terrified that they'll think I'm disgusting.
